events.title: Laufey
events.description: Modern jazz sensation Laufey performs a headline show featuring her signature blend of jazz and contemporary pop. Expect a polished performance showcasing orchestral arrangements and soulful vocals.

events.title: Massive Attack
events.description: Legendary trip-hop pioneers Massive Attack bring their atmospheric and politically charged audio-visual live experience to Brisbane. The show is known for its immersive soundscapes and large-scale projections.

events.title: Wage War, Orthodox & HEAVENSGATE
events.description: A high-energy night of heavy metalcore featuring headliners Wage War alongside supporting acts Orthodox and HEAVENSGATE. Expect intense, technically proficient live performance in an intimate venue setting.

events.title: Plini and Delta Sleep
events.description: An evening of progressive rock and intricate guitar-driven melodies featuring virtuosic performer Plini and math-rock band Delta Sleep. Ideal for fans of complex rhythms and instrumental songwriting.

events.title: The Hot Toddies
events.description: A live music showcase featuring The Hot Toddies at The Triffid, a popular venue known for its converted hangar aesthetic and focus on quality sound.

events.title: 1tbsp
events.description: Electronic artist 1tbsp brings their dance-leaning, indie-electronic sound to the Princess Theatre. Expect a dynamic night of house-inspired beats and melodic production.

events.title: Humbe
events.description: Mexican singer-songwriter Humbe brings his fusion of pop and contemporary Latin sounds to the Brisbane stage for an intimate show.

events.title: Toni Childs
events.description: Acclaimed singer-songwriter Toni Childs performs a career-spanning live concert at the Redland Performing Arts Centre. Known for her powerful voice and storytelling, this show focuses on her classic hits and newer work.

events.title: Cat & Calmell
events.description: Dynamic pop duo Cat & Calmell perform their catchy, genre-bending music at The Brightside. Expect an energetic set featuring their unique blend of electronic and pop influences.

events.title: Pinky Beecroft Super Massive
events.description: An alternative rock night at Crowbar featuring Pinky Beecroft Super Massive. Expect a high-volume, gritty performance characteristic of this local staple venue.

events.title: A.D. Heaven, Plainer Headland (AU) & Noir et Blanc
events.description: A triple bill featuring local experimental and indie acts at the Season Three arts space. A great opportunity to see smaller-scale, creative music in a non-traditional venue.

events.title: Chandler Jay
events.location: New Farm Bowls Club, New Farm
events.description: Chandler Jay performs an intimate set at the relaxed atmosphere of the New Farm Bowls Club. This venue offers a unique, casual setting to enjoy live music.

events.title: Verona Lights
events.description: Verona Lights bring their brand of high-energy rock to Crowbar. Expect a loud, late-night atmosphere characteristic of this valley mainstay.

events.title: Anuv Jain
events.description: Indian singer-songwriter Anuv Jain performs his emotive, acoustic-based pop music. Known for his viral sentimental ballads, expect an intimate and stripped-back performance.

events.title: Grace Cummings
events.description: Grace Cummings performs her evocative, folk-leaning music at the historic Old Museum. Her powerful voice and raw storytelling are well-suited to this heritage-listed venue.

events.title: ISHAN (AU)
events.description: ISHAN performs in the cozy, retro-inspired confines of the Junk Bar. This small-capacity venue provides a personal and quiet environment for singer-songwriters.
